snippet.title: "Fate/EXTRA Record" Character Introduction Trailer(SABER)
snippet.description:
SABER（VA: Sakura Tange）
One of the Servants the protagonist can make a contract with. Her small frame belies her unbelievable skill as a swordswoman. With her high combat capability, she's fit to bear the name "Saber." While she may come across as arrogant, she harbors a secret love of all things beautiful.

The Moon Holy Grail War Reborn ---

Fate/EXTRA Record is coming to PlayStation®5, PlayStation®4, Nintendo Switch™ 2, Nintendo Switch™, and Steam® worldwide on January 28, 2027!

Physical editions are available for pre-order now.
Digital pre-orders will be available on each platform at a later date.
 
Product Information
-Title: Fate/EXTRA Record
-Genre: Dungeon Exploration RPG
-Release Date: January 28, 2027
-Platforms: PlayStation®5 / PlayStation®4 / Nintendo Switch™ 2 / Nintendo Switch™ / Steam®
-Number of Players: 1
-Rating: CERO C
-Subtitle Languages: Japanese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
-Voice Language: Japanese
-Staff:
  Original Work / Scenario Supervisor: Kinoko Nasu
  Original Character Concept: Takashi Takeuchi
  Character Design: RCO WADA
  Developer: Meteorise
  Planning: TYPE-MOON
  Publisher: Aniplex
